what: Video with sound from text, images or reference clips.
dossier:
Decision Rule:
1.  If the task involves zero, one, or two input images (Text-to-Video, First-Frame-to-Video, Last-Frame-to-Video, or First-and-Last-Frame-to-Video):
       Then select H3-Base-FL2VA (First-and-last-frame mode) [MODEL.md] [SOURCES.md].
2.  If the task involves multi-modal reference inputs (up to 9 images, up to 3 video clips, up to 3 audio clips):
       Then select H3-Base-Ref2VA (Omni-reference mode) [MODEL.md] [SOURCES.md]. The following models are required for the MiniMax H3 pipeline. Local files are located in _complete_pipelines/MiniMax-H3 [MODEL.md].

templates_list.name: image_minimax_h3_t2i
templates_list.title: MiniMax H3: Text to Image
templates_list.desc: Generate a single still image from a text prompt with MiniMax H3, an omni-modal video model used here for its first-frame decode. No file inputs required: the graph samples an empty latent and decodes it through the H3 video VAE. Best suited to a single subject with a defined light source and a simple or blurred background.

The workflow takes 1 input image and produces 1 video output, with optional text or reference media to steer motion, style, or sound. templates_list.name: video_minimax_h3_i2v_continuation
templates_list.title: Image to Video
templates_list.desc: Start with an image and an empty prompt, then describe the motion, shots, and audio you want MiniMax H3 to generate. The workflow produces one video with synchronized audio and remains fully editable before execution.

templates_list.name: video_minimax_h3_multiframe_reference
templates_list.title: MiniMax H3: Multiframe Reference
templates_list.desc: Generate video from multiple still images with MiniMax H3, anchoring up to four reference frames anywhere along the timeline to control motion and composition. Ideal for creating video continuations from existing clips, forcing narrative beats at specific moments, and producing footage with synchronized native audio for cinematic or social media content.

Output is a single MP4 video at up to 2K resolution and 24fps for roughly 15 seconds. Ideal for character-con

templates_list.name: video_minimax_h3_t2v
templates_list.title: MiniMax H3: Text to Video
templates_list.desc: Generate video with native stereo audio directly from a text prompt using MiniMax H3, an omni-modal model that synthesizes voice, sound effects, and music in a single pass. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and roughly 15 seconds long, with no file inputs required — just a prompt to one video output. Ideal for rapid concept visualization, social media content creation, and audio-synced storyte

templates_list.name: video_fasth3_ominiref_r2v
templates_list.title: FastH3 OmniRef: Reference to Video
templates_list.desc: Generate synchronized video with matching audio from a text prompt plus a reference image using the FastH3 OmniRef eight-step distilled model, which renders both streams in just eight sampling steps. Takes 1 input image and produces 1 video output. Ideal for animating reference characters, creating talking avatars, and rapid social media video prototyping.

templates_list.name: video_fastvideo_fasth3_i2v
templates_list.title: FastVideo FastH3: Image to Video
templates_list.desc: Generate video with synchronized native audio from a single still image using MiniMax H3 and the FastH3 8-step checkpoint. One image produces one video output with matching voice, sound effects, and music in a single pass. Ideal for animating portraits, bringing product shots to life, and quick social media clips.

templates_list.name: video_fastvideo_fasth3_t2v

templates_list.desc: Generate synchronized video and audio directly from text using a distilled eight-step model, producing one video output with no file inputs required. Ideal for rapid text-to-video prototyping, audio-visual content creation, and creative storytelling where fast generation matters more than maximum detail.
